fatal_blockers: P1: Delaunay gluing is not an emitted CVP construction: the lattice basis, target, facet-identification maps, completeness radius, and unrestricted enumeration bound are unspecified. Linear facet equalities retain G13/G15 affine pseudosections, while no argument excludes G12 drops or shows hole depth dominates the growing completeness baseline as required by G20.

P2: The variable u already has dimension 2^n, so compressing only Hu cannot yield a polynomial-time reduction. Parseval merely rescales ||u||_2; there is no proof that unsatisfiable marginal equations force n^epsilon mass rather than a constant-mass signed solution, and a four-variable test cannot discriminate the missing asymptotic compression or mass-versus-baseline theorem.

P3: Mapping-cone boundary equations are linear and therefore preserve coefficient-sum-one affine combinations of honest chains, exactly the G13/G15 obstruction. No explicit cells, restriction maps, formula-dependent torsion class, target cycle, or systolic-to-CVP ratio are supplied; attaching local Moore cells may instead create constant-support torsion representatives.

P4: Ordered path signatures are nonlinear under concatenation. Any selector/table linearization reintroduces signed pseudodistributions and G19-style splicing unless a new integral rigidity theorem is proved; fixed degree gives no growing-gap law, while growing degree has superpolynomial dimension. The proposed program, signature coordinates, basis, target, and shell certificate are not frozen.

P5: Full-adder table marginals cannot make the exact zero fiber Boolean. If T0 and T1 are the two honest complete traces for residues 0 and 1, then 2T0-T1 has normalization one and satisfies every linear wiring, multiplication, carry, and idempotence marginal while being a signed non-Boolean pseudotrace. Its anchor excess scales with circuit size alongside the completeness baseline, yielding at best a constant ratio; the proposed depth-independent-excess kill condition would miss this decisive G13/G15 affine lift.

P6: Minimum-Frobenius transportation matrices being permutations does not imply a polynomial gap. A persistent non-permutation defect costs Theta(L) while the honest transport baseline is also Theta(L), giving only a constant ratio, and query-split layers still permit G19-type signed cycles. No mechanism defeats G12 layer drops or the G20 baseline objection.
evidence: G13 verifies an explicit constant-excess harmful selector that is an integral affine combination of honest encodings with coefficient sum one. Every compatible linear syndrome vanishes on it.

G15 verifies that the same affine coefficients thread every level of an enlarged hierarchy with exactly zero residual. This directly refutes relying on additional linear restriction, carry, chain, or table layers alone.

G19 finds a zero-residual accepting signed splice in a fully emitted 3,250-layer branching program, with obstruction/control squared minima 22,770 and 22,754. Noncommutative or transport proposals supply no verified rigidity escaping that mechanism.
G12 demonstrates clause dropping after a parity fingerprint is strengthened, while G14 supplies only a finite pair-bag shell pass and explicitly no composition or growing-gap theorem.
No verifier evidence accompanies any Generation-21 construction. All supplied positive results are finite-instance facts and establish neither a hardness lemma nor an n^c approximation gap.
next_experiment: None authorized.
